description: SvDateTimePicker, the Svelte 5 date-time picker that is also the SvGrid datetime cell editor: a masked text input plus a dropdown that composes the calendar and the clock behind Date and Time tabs. Type a value in the formatString pattern or pick it, invalid input reverts, and the dropdown portals to the body so it is never clipped; min and max, nullable, 12 or 24-hour and spin buttons are props.

faq.question: How do I control the text format?
faq.answer: Pass formatString, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm. The input masks typing to that pattern and parses it back; a value that does not parse reverts to the last valid one.

faq.question: Can I show only the calendar or only the clock?
faq.answer: Yes. dropDownDisplayMode accepts both, calendar or time; the Date and Time tabs appear only in the combined mode, and hourFormat picks 12-hour or 24-hour time.

faq.question: Why does the dropdown portal to the body?
faq.answer: So a picker inside a scrolling panel, a table cell or a dialog is never clipped by overflow rules. Focus and keyboard handling stay attached to the input.
